ios.notes:
The play button is now brushed metal, with a ring of light that turns when you play or pause.
Forgot your password? You can now reset it from Duotone with a code we email you.

Duotone for iPhone 6.1.2

New
- The metal play button, as on the PC: a brushed-metal disc with a ring of light that spins up when you press play and brakes like a turntable when you pause. It's the new default in Now Playing and the mini player; pick another style in Customise → Play button.
- "Forgot password?" on the sign-in screen, and "Reset password" in Settings: we email you a code, and you choose the new password right there.

Improved
- Spotify playlist links with more than 100 songs now bring the rest too, up to 1000.
- Fewer requests in the background: the heart no longer asks the server about every song you play.

Minimum version: 6.0.1

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v6.1.1...ios-v6.1.2

windows.notes:
The cover that flies into Now Playing turns from flat to 3D on the way, lands without a blink, and already leans toward your mouse.

Duotone for Windows 7.0.5

Improved
- Opening Now Playing, the cover leaves the player bar flat, like the thumbnail, and becomes the 3D cover halfway there. Closing, it flattens back before it reaches the bar.
- The cover lands at the exact size of the one on the page, so it no longer arrives small and then jumps bigger.
- With the 3D cover, it arrives already tilted toward the mouse, instead of resting and then snapping when the mouse moves.
- Without the 3D cover, the flat cover's corners now match the thumbnail in the player bar.

Minimum version: 7.0.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/win-v7.0.4...win-v7.0.5

windowsPreview.notes:
Duotone Preview 0.2.0

New
- Social redesigned: conversations without a frame, the friend you're listening with in a resizable panel on the right, the window takes their cover's colour, and messages, rows and panels animate in and out.
- The Preview now updates itself (installed copy only).

Improved
- Panels, dialogs, notices, menus and the selection bar slide in and out instead of popping.

Fixed
- Settings restored from your account after launch (3D cover, two-tone covers, layout, colour) now apply right away.
- The Preview no longer asks you to install the Duotone update.
- Friend lists could jump far off screen while reordering.
